Home.title: Islamic Society of Toronto
Home.description: Faith, knowledge, and community — serving Toronto's Muslim families since 1995.
Home.welcomeTitle: A place to pray, learn, and belong
Home.welcomeBody: Find live prayer times, weekly programs, community services, and ways to connect.

Visit.title: Find us at Masjid Darus Salaam
Visit.description: Directions, parking warnings, and what to expect before arriving at 20 Overlea Blvd.
Visit.parkingBody: Do not park at 25 Overlea Blvd or East York Town Centre. These private lots actively tow unauthorized vehicles.
Visit.firstBody: Arrive early for Jummah, dress modestly, silence phones, and follow on-site signs for prayer areas. Contact the office ahead for accessibility needs.

Contact.title: Get in touch
Contact.description: Ask the IST office about education, Nikah, Janazah, volunteering, events, or a first visit.
Contact.hoursBody: Availability changes around prayers and programs. Call or email ahead so staff can confirm a suitable time.

Prayer.boardNote: The masjid board is shown below. Times are synchronized from IST's Prayer Clock.

Events.description: Browse the community calendar or subscribe from your calendar app.

NewMuslim.title: New to Islam or the masjid?
NewMuslim.description: Start at your pace. We welcome new Muslims, people exploring Islam, and anyone returning to faith.
NewMuslim.visitBody: Observe a prayer, ask questions, or simply become familiar with the masjid.
NewMuslim.shahadaBody: An Imam can explain its meaning and help with practical next steps.
NewMuslim.prayerBody: Begin with purification, the movements of Salah, and a few short surahs.
NewMuslim.communityBody: The office can connect brothers and sisters with suitable classes and support.

Zakat.title: Zakat calculator
Zakat.description: A Canadian-dollar estimate to organize your figures before speaking with a qualified scholar.
Zakat.disclaimer: This tool is an estimate, not a fatwa. Confirm nisab, eligible assets, debts, and lunar-year requirements with an Imam.
Zakat.nisabPlaceholder: Enter a current threshold from a trusted source
Zakat.enterNisab: Enter a current nisab threshold to check eligibility.
Zakat.eligible: Your net amount meets the threshold entered.
Zakat.below: Your net amount is below the threshold entered.

Volunteer.title: Volunteer with IST
Volunteer.description: Tell us the role that interests you and when you are available. The team will follow up when a suitable opportunity opens.
